summary: Q2 MULTI-ROUND AGENTIC / DAG ARM (avenue a: runAgenticContextSearches via GET /subconscious/assignment?agentic_context=1) — does NOT select code_nodes; closed ZERO single-shot misses (recall 0.000, 0/13 hits; every query: n_context_selected=1, context_kinds=['task'], confidence=1.0, stop_reason='confidence_high'). PRECISE ROOT CAUSE (verified by dumping the envelope, lib/subconscious/index.js): round-1 task_gated_dag returns 0 results (gate_reason 'no-notes'); round-2 broad_rag_context DOES retrieve the code_nodes (result_count 10 — gateTask/classifyNoteType/externalGap are present as tier 'code'). BUT the agentic SELECTION picks only ONE item: the bench PROBE TASK ITSELF (key bench/<probe>, kind 'task', rank_score 0.676 — its summary IS the query, so it self-matches). rankResults gives the code tier tierBoost=0 while the task self-match dominates, so the probe out-ranks every code_node; that single task selection saturates confidence to 1.0 and agenticStopReason (index.js:711: selected_count>0 && confidence>=HIGH_CONFIDENCE => 'confidence_high') stops the loop before any code_node is promoted. So: code_nodes ARE retrieved by the agentic rounds but NEVER selected — the agentic/DAG
